problem_type: <str> Fixed tag identifying the problem family; always 'JSSP_DEADLINE'.
num_jobs: <int> Number of jobs J. Jobs are indexed 0 .. num_jobs-1.
num_machines: <int> Number of machines M. Machines are indexed 0 .. num_machines-1.
num_operations: <int> Total number of operations across all jobs (= sum of the length of every job's operation sequence).
deadline: <int> Common hard deadline D: every job's completion time must be <= D; equivalently the schedule makespan must be <= D.

jobs.job_id: <int> Identifier of this job, unique and ranging over 0 .. num_jobs-1.

operations.machine: <int> Index of the machine (0 .. num_machines-1) that must process this operation.
operations.processing_time: <int> Number of consecutive time units this operation occupies on its machine (>= 1).
